d: Short, messy crimson hair with choppy bangs and a side-swept fringe frames a youthful, mature face with narrow, reddish-brown eyes behind thin-rimmed glasses. This slender build is dressed in a white button-up shirt tucked into a short black skirt, layered with a long burnt-orange coat draped over the shoulders, black sheer tights with a criss-cross strap detail on the thigh, and black pumps. Accessories include a black choker with a large silver ring, black fingerless gloves, and a black rectangular clutch held in one hand. BODY COLOR: pale LEGS: plantigrade, human-style feet
